onValueCommitted.notes: Fires after typing+blur, or on pointer release after scrub/button press; simultaneous with onValueChange for keyboard and wheel. It is a generic event, not a change event (no cancel()).

min/max.notes: Clamping boundaries; also used for Home/End keys.

step.notes: 'any' disables step validation; interactive stepping then uses base amount 1 while alt/shift still use small/largeStep.

allowOutOfRange.notes: Text entry may exceed min/max (native range underflow/overflow validation applies); step interactions still clamp.

allowWheelScrub.notes: Wheel changes the value while focused+hovered.

name/form/disabled/readOnly/required/id/.notes: Standard field wiring; inputRef targets the hidden input.

ScrubArea.teleportDistance.notes: Wraps the cursor back around after travelling this far from the scrub-area centre (Pointer Lock API).

Input.aria-roledescription.notes: Role description, not the accessible name.

dataAttributes: data-scrubbing — present on Root, Group, Input, ScrubArea, ScrubAreaCursor and the steppers while scrubbing
data-valid / data-invalid, data-dirty / data-touched, data-filled, data-focused (inside Field.Root)

renderProp.elementForm: render={<div />} / render={<button />} (Increment/Decrement, with nativeButton when replaced)

controlled.note: Two distinct callbacks: change (every keystroke) vs commit (blur / pointer release). React Aria's NumberField only has onChange.

formIntegration.hiddenInput: Root renders a hidden input carrying name, value (or ''), min, max and form, which is what participates in submission and in native validation (inputRef points at it).
formIntegration.validation: required + min/max/step participate in native constraint validation; step validation only applies when min is set explicitly.

keyboard.keys: ArrowUp/ArrowDown step (Alt = smallStep, Shift = largeStep); Home -> min and End -> max when those props are set; PageUp/Insert/F-keys are left to the browser; typing digits produces 'input-change', clearing produces 'input-clear'.
keyboard.focus: Input keeps its own caret/selection handling (1.8.0 preserves native and consumer-controlled selection on focus).

notableDifferences: React Aria's NumberField exposes isDisabled/isReadOnly/isRequired/isInvalid/formatOptions; Base UI uses disabled/readOnly/required + format/locale.
Scrubbing is a first-class part (ScrubArea + ScrubAreaCursor with Pointer Lock), rather than a prop.
Steppers are separate Increment/Decrement parts that you place inside Group — React Aria renders them via slots/props.
Two-phase value reporting: onValueChange (live) and onValueCommitted (settled), with a rich reason union that encodes how the value changed.
allowOutOfRange and snapOnStep are Base UI-specific behaviours with no React Aria counterpart.
